clause: The normative `StudioInterpolation` enumeration is five members
spec_anchor_status: RESOLVED: derived from the assembled Master Spec module, not provisional

scope.summary: The normative `StudioInterpolation` enumeration is five members.** *Derivation: enumeration table, taken whole; yields 1 microtask whose acceptance criteria are its members.* | Member | Behaviour | |---|---| | `linear` | Constant rate between the two keyframes. | | `bezier` | Rate shaped by an independently editable tangent on each side of the keyframe. The two sides do not constrain each other, so a corner in the value curve is expressible. | | `continuous_bezier` | Bezier whose two tangents are constrained to be collinear, so the curve passes through the keyframe smoothly. Adjusting one side rotates the other. | | `auto_bezier` | Continuous bezier whose tangent direction is computed from the neighbouring keyframes and re-computed when they move. Editing either tangent by hand converts it to `continuous_bezier`. | | `hold` | The value is held at this keyframe until the next one, then jumps. A `hold` out-interpolation makes the segment a step regardless of the next keyframe's in-interpolation. |
scope.spec_text_is_authority: The clause text above is quoted from the Master Spec. Where this contract and the spec differ, the spec wins and this contract is regenerated.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
